title: Carolina Collection Guest Towel Stand (16.3-Inch) - Solid Brass Countertop Vanity Hand Towel Stand | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep guest towels within reach of the sink while keeping the vanity tidy. The Carolina Collection guest towel stand adds stable, countertop towel storage with a traditional, classic look.

  • Organize at the vanity: two arms hold guest towels, hand towels, and washcloths right where they’re used
  • Stays put on the counter: heavy base is designed to help prevent tipping
  • Protects surfaces: felt pad on the bottom helps prevent scratching on countertops
  • Easy to coordinate: ideal for matching Carolina with other traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories
  • Built from brass: crafted from solid brass materials

Specs
Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 16.3 x 14 x 5.5 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 8 x 8 in.
Shipping weight: 7 lbs.
Finish options: multiple designer finish options available
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
